scope: large/OBQA, R/Text, fixed Text reference; gold-budget sensitivity only
subset_rng: random.Random(r), shuffle sorted complete original fit IDs, nested prefixes
quantile: inverse empirical CDF, ceil(q*2100), ties included, q=1 fixed R (+infinity)
FWER_scope: Each repeat only: D/R2100/R32_r/R128_r/R512_r, 100 hypotheses; five overlapping repeats are not a joint .10 FWER search or independent draws
selection: largest accepted q per family; otherwise fixed Text; evaluate all 15 on dev
label_interface: Each fitter receives only B IDs, B cached z and B y_R; no other fit correctness/d, y_T, cal correctness, old soft labels or initial parameters
constant_rule: single class -> exact class probability; no LR call, no resampling

cost.head_selector_ms: reuse parent correctness-R per-query measured timing for every new selective head; same structure proxy
cost.constant_fee: zero feature/head for fixed R or Text
cost.identity: component recomposition proxy; no new feature timing or end-to-end measurement

markers.utility_crossover: cal-selected selective policy AND dev point conditional change<=.05 AND U>=unchanged parent D U
markers.cost_accuracy_crossover: same cal/dev risk conditions AND correct>=643 AND mean_cost_ms<=797.166236
markers.D_U_comparison: exact parent D U, not rounded prompt display
markers.head_timing_sensitivity: flag crossover lost if replacing new R timing by parent D per-query timing; diagnostic only, no decision changes

bootstrap.joint_indices: one PCG64 default_rng stream; same question indices for all five models vs D
bootstrap.interval: conditional on frozen models, not label sampling uncertainty; 2.5/97.5 percentile descriptive

ranking: AUROC/AP vs d, Spearman with frozen D; matched coverage stable dev-order sort, no new deployment thresholds
historical_exposure: Historical train/dev influenced earlier research decisions and reference choice. New split isolates this computation only; no restoration of untouched independent confirmatory status.

work_posthoc_description.authority: current Work prompt; descriptive, no new audit or equivalence claim
